entries.en: Treasured by adventurers and explorers alike
entries.translated: Tiek nuotykių ieškotojų, tiek tyrinėtojų vertinamas

entries.en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
entries.translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

entries.en: Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>
entries.translated: Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
entries.translated: Ambasadoriaus namuose nieko nerandate. Jei jis iš tikrųjų yra išdavikas, jis atsikratė jokių įrodymų, galinčių jį apkaltinti.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Jūs atidžiai išnagrinėjate ritinius. Tai yra Rathleton įsakymai ambasadoriui. Čia nėra išdavystės ženklų.

entries.en: Paper scraps lie scattered on the floor. It takes some time to put them back together. But it's only a badly written poem.
entries.translated: Popieriaus likučiai guli išmėtyti ant grindų. Prireiks šiek tiek laiko, kol juos vėl sujungsite. Bet tai tik blogai parašytas eilėraštis.

entries.en: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
entries.translated: Neseniai čia buvo sudeginti dokumentai. Tik vieno ritinio dalis vis dar guli prieš kaminą, bet ji per daug suodinta, kad būtų galima perskaityti.

entries.en: You were moved to the left brain side
entries.translated: Jūs buvote perkeltas į kairę smegenų pusę

entries.en: You were moved to the right brain side
entries.translated: Jūs buvote perkeltas į dešinę smegenų pusę

entries.en: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Jaučiatės drebulys ir svaigsta galva, pasaulis aplink jus tamsėja. Tada tavo regėjimas vėl praskaidrėja – ir tu esi kažkur kitur.

entries.en: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely notice you. I am so lost in my thoughts.
entries.translated: Ach, cítím, že smrtelník znovu prochází těmito prastarými síněmi. Promiň, sotva si tě všímám. Jsem tak ztracený ve svých myšlenkách.

entries.en: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
entries.translated: Nyní budete odsud odcestováni. Jsi si jistý, že chceš čelit tomu teleportu?

entries.en: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
entries.translated: Pak zůstaň tady v těchto strašidelných síních.

entries.en: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.
entries.translated: Cítím tě. Slyším tvé myšlenky. Jste... naživu.

entries.en: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
entries.translated: Jednou jsem byl členem řádu rytířů z nočních můr. Teď jsem jen stín, který se prochází těmito chladnými chodbami.

entries.en: The north has a puzzle to complete.
Interesting. A human who can speak the language of wolves.
entries.translated: Zajímavý. Člověk, který umí mluvit jazykem vlků.

entries.en: I can see in your eyes that you are a honest and friendly person, |PLAYERNAME|. You were patient enough to learn our language and I will grant you a special gift. Will you accept it?
entries.translated: Vidím ve tvých očích, že jsi čestný a přátelský člověk, |PLAYERNAME|. Byli jste dostatečně trpěliví, abyste se naučili náš jazyk, a já vám dám zvláštní dárek. Přijmete to?

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the wolf girl. You shall be fast and smart as Morgrar, the great white wolf. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: Od této chvíle budete známí jako |PLAYERNAME|, vlčí dívka. Budete rychlý a chytrý jako Morgrar, velký bílý vlk. On povede vaši cestu.

entries.en: From now on, you shall be known as |PLAYERNAME|, the bear warrior. You shall be strong and proud as Angros, the great dark bear. He shall guide your path.
entries.translated: Od této chvíle budete známí jako |PLAYERNAME|, medvědí válečník. Budete silní a hrdí jako Angros, velký tmavý medvěd. On povede vaši cestu.

entries.en: Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics.
Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
entries.translated: Co? Co? Vidím! Páni! A non-mino. {capture} vás také?

entries.en: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, \z I will give you something. Hehehe!
entries.translated: Skvělá hádanka, že? Pokud mi můžete říct správnou odpověď, \z něco vám dám. Hehehe!

entries.en: All the players need to be level
entries.translated: All the players need to be level

entries.en: You must wait. Someone is challenging
entries.translated: You must wait. Someone is challenging

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
entries.translated: V Ambasadorově domě nic nenajdete. Pokud je ve skutečnosti zrádce, zbavil se všech důkazů, které by ho mohly usvědčovat.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Pečlivě prozkoumáte svitky. To jsou příkazy od Rathleton pro velvyslance. Žádné známky zrady.

entries.en: Paper scraps lie scattered on the floor. It takes some time to put them back together. But it's only a badly written poem.
entries.translated: Útržky papíru leží rozházené na podlaze. Dávat je zase dohromady nějakou dobu trvá. Ale je to jen špatně napsaná báseň.

entries.en: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
entries.translated: Nedávno zde byly spáleny dokumenty. Pouze část jednoho svitku stále leží před komínem, ale je příliš zašpiněná na čtení.

entries.en: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
entries.translated: Αν έρθει άλλος πρίγκιπας να με φιλήσει, θα του κλωτσήσω τόσο άσχημα που θα χρειαστεί μια καρέκλα σεντάν για να ξεφύγει.

entries.en: Don't even try to kiss me or I'll rondhouse kick you!
entries.translated: Μην προσπαθήσεις καν να με φιλήσεις αλλιώς θα σε κλωτσήσω!

entries.en: Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
entries.translated: Δεν υπάρχουν βατράχια που μιλάνε, ηλίθιε. Είναι η γαμημένη φαντασία σου που σε ξεγελάει. Και τώρα η φαντασία σου σε διατάζει να φύγεις.

entries.en: Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
entries.translated: Επιτέλους κάποιος παρατηρεί ότι είμαι ΒΑΤΡΑΧΟΣ. Συγχαρητήρια είσαι ΠΟΛΥ παρατηρητικός... *αναστεναγμός*

entries.en: A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
entries.translated: Μια αναζήτηση; Ναι, έχω μια αναζήτηση! Πήγαινε και πες στον βασιλιά Τιβιανό ο γιος του προσπάθησε να με φιλήσει ξανά!

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pyrale; Αυτός ο ηλίθιος με μεταμόρφωσε κάποτε σε άνθρωπο. Αλλά η γυναίκα μου ήρθε και με φίλησε, άρα είμαι πάλι βάτραχος.

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pyrale; Αυτός ο ηλίθιος με μεταμόρφωσε κάποτε σε άνθρωπο. Αλλά η γυναίκα μου ήρθε και με φίλησε, άρα είμαι πάλι βάτραχος.
Χαχα! Αυτός ο ηλίθιος τελικά έφυγε.

entries.en: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely notice you. I am so lost in my thoughts.
entries.translated: Αχ, νιώθω ότι ένας θνητός περπατά ξανά σε αυτές τις αρχαίες αίθουσες. Με συγχωρείτε, δεν σας προσέχω καθόλου. Είμαι τόσο χαμένος στις σκέψεις μου.

entries.en: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
entries.translated: Τώρα θα ταξιδέψετε από εδώ. Είστε σίγουροι ότι θέλετε να αντιμετωπίσετε αυτήν την τηλεμεταφορά;?

entries.en: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
entries.translated: Τότε μείνετε εδώ σε αυτές τις φανταστικές αίθουσες.

entries.en: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.
entries.translated: Σε νιώθω. Ακούω τις σκέψεις σας. Είσαι ... ζωντανός.

entries.en: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
entries.translated: Κάποτε ήμουν μέλος του τάγματος των εφιαλτικών ιπποτών. Τώρα δεν είμαι παρά μια σκιά που περπατά σε αυτές τις κρύες αίθουσες.

entries.en: The north has a puzzle to complete.
entries.translated: Ο βορράς έχει να συμπληρώσει ένα παζλ.

entries.en: Interesting. A human who can speak the language of wolves.
entries.translated: Ενδιαφέρων. Ένας άνθρωπος που μπορεί να μιλήσει τη γλώσσα των λύκων.

entries.en: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
entries.translated: Δεν βρίσκετε τίποτα στο σπίτι του Πρέσβη. Εάν είναι στην πραγματικότητα προδότης, απαλλάχθηκε από κάθε στοιχείο που θα μπορούσε να τον ενοχοποιήσει.

entries.en: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
entries.translated: Εξετάζετε προσεκτικά τους κυλίνδρους. Αυτές είναι εντολές από Rathleton για τον Πρέσβη. Κανένα σημάδι προδοσίας εδώ.

entries.en: Paper scraps lie scattered on the floor. It takes some time to put them back together. But it's only a badly written poem.
entries.translated: Τα υπολείμματα χαρτιού βρίσκονται διάσπαρτα στο πάτωμα. Χρειάζεται λίγος χρόνος για να τα συνδυάσετε ξανά. Αλλά είναι μόνο ένα κακογραμμένο ποίημα.

entries.en: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
entries.translated: Έγγραφα κάηκαν εδώ πρόσφατα. Μόνο το μέρος του ενός κυλίνδρου βρίσκεται ακόμα μπροστά από την καμινάδα, αλλά είναι πολύ βρεγμένο για να το διαβάσετε.

entries.en: You were moved to the left brain side
entries.translated: Μετακινηθήκατε στην αριστερή πλευρά του εγκεφάλου

entries.en: You were moved to the right brain side
entries.translated: Μετακινηθήκατε στη δεξιά πλευρά του εγκεφάλου

entries.en: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
entries.translated: Νιώθεις τρέμουλο και ζαλάδα, ο κόσμος σκοτεινιάζει γύρω σου. Τότε η όρασή σας καθαρίζει ξανά - και βρίσκεστε κάπου αλλού.

entries.en: As I told you, fiendish ice creatures dragged my egg into the lower caves. ...
entries.translated: Come ti ho detto, diaboliche creature del ghiaccio hanno trascinato il mio uovo nelle caverne inferiori. ...

entries.en: Without enough heat the egg will die soon. Venture there and save my hatchling and the knowledge you seeek shall be yours!
entries.translated: Senza abbastanza calore l'uovo morirà presto. Avventurati lì e salva il mio cucciolo e la conoscenza che cerchi sarà tua!

entries.en: So return to the upper tunnels where cultists and ice golems dwell. Somewhere in these tunnels you will find a small prison haunted by a ghost. South of this prison cell there is a tunnel that will lead you eastwards. ...
entries.translated: Quindi torna ai tunnel superiori dove dimorano cultisti e golem di ghiaccio. Da qualche parte in questi tunnel troverai una piccola prigione infestata da un fantasma. A sud di questa cella c'è un tunnel che ti condurrà verso est. ...

entries.en: Follow the tunnel until you reach a small cave. Step down and down until you see a blue energy field. It will lead you to my egg. It is sealed so that not everyone may enter the room. But you have the permission now.
entries.translated: Seguite il tunnel fino a raggiungere una piccola grotta. Scendi sempre più finché non vedi un campo energetico blu. Ti condurrà al mio uovo. È sigillato in modo che non tutti possano entrare nella stanza. Ma adesso hai il permesso.

entries.en: Wretched creatures of ice have stolen my egg that was close to hatching. ...
entries.translated: Miserabili creature del ghiaccio mi hanno rubato l'uovo che stava per schiudersi. ...

entries.en: Since I'm to huge to enter those lower Tunnels I have to ask you to take care of my {egg}. Will you do this?
entries.translated: Dato che sono troppo grande per entrare in quei tunnel inferiori, devo chiederti di prenderti cura del mio {egg}. Lo farai?

entries.en: I'm aware what you are looking for. Usually I would rather devour you, but due to unfortunate circumstances, I need your {assistance}.
entries.translated: So cosa stai cercando. Di solito preferirei divorarti, ma a causa di circostanze sfortunate, ho bisogno del tuo {assistance}.

entries.en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
entries.translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

entries.en: Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>
entries.translated: Eh? Ehh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>

entries.en: Yeah, good bye and don't come again!
entries.translated: Sì, arrivederci e non tornare più!

entries.en: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
entries.translated: Se un altro principe viene a baciarmi, gli prendo a calci così forte che avrà bisogno di una portantina per scappare.

entries.en: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
entries.translated: Se un altro principe viene a baciarmi, gli prendo a calci così forte che avrà bisogno di una portantina per scappare.

entries.en: Don't even try to kiss me or I'll rondhouse kick you!
entries.translated: Non provare nemmeno a baciarmi o ti prendo a calci!

entries.en: Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
entries.translated: Le rane parlanti non esistono, idiota. E' la tua dannata immaginazione che ti inganna. E ora la tua immaginazione ti ordina di andartene.

entries.en: Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
entries.translated: Finalmente qualcuno si accorge che sono una RANA. Congratulazioni, sei MOLTO attento... *sigh*

entries.en: A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
entries.translated: Una ricerca? Sì, ho una missione! Va' a dire al re Tibiano che suo figlio ha provato a baciarmi ancora!

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pirale? Quell'idiota una volta mi ha trasformato in un essere umano. Ma mia moglie è venuta e mi ha baciato, quindi sono di nuovo una rana.

entries.en: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
entries.translated: Pirale? Quell'idiota una volta mi ha trasformato in un essere umano. Ma mia moglie è venuta e mi ha baciato, quindi sono di nuovo una rana.
Ah! Quell'idiota finalmente se n'è andato.

entries.en: Your body is heating up, the air around you is flickering.
entries.translated: Il tuo corpo si sta riscaldando, l'aria intorno a te tremola.

entries.en: The heat is now unbearable, the blood in your body feels like lava. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!
entries.translated: Il caldo è ormai insopportabile, il sangue nel tuo corpo sembra lava. Non hai quasi più la forza: agisci velocemente!

entries.en: Embrace the stigma of bad fortune. The tar does not feel so hot anymore. You passed the tar trial.
entries.translated: Abbraccia lo stigma della sfortuna. Il catrame non è più così caldo. Hai superato il processo del tar.

entries.en: Your body reacts to this strange green substance as you reach out to touch it. You feel an urge for more of this energy.
entries.translated: Il tuo corpo reagisce a questa strana sostanza verde quando allunghi la mano per toccarla. Senti il ​​bisogno di avere più di questa energia.

entries.en: The tar covering you has cooled down and fell off for the most part. Your body is not heated up anymore.
entries.translated: Il catrame che ti ricopre si è raffreddato ed è caduto in gran parte. Il tuo corpo non è più riscaldato.

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this decaying soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting
entries.translated: Assorbi i resti energetici di quest'anima in decomposizione. Il suo potere è molto fragile e fugace

entries.en: You absorb the energetic remains of this whitering soul. Its power is very fragile and fleeting.
entries.translated: Assorbi i resti energetici di quest'anima sbiancante. Il suo potere è molto fragile e fugace.

entries.en: You need exactly 10 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno esattamente di 10 giocatori per iniziare questa sfida.

entries.en: You need exactly 5 players to start this challenge.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno esattamente di 5 giocatori per iniziare questa sfida.

entries.en: You need to wait for 10 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Devi aspettare 10 ore per affrontare di nuovo questo boss.

entries.en: You need to wait for 20 hours to face this boss again.
entries.translated: Devi aspettare 20 ore per affrontare di nuovo questo boss.

entries.en: Couldn't find any position for you right now.
entries.translated: Impossibile trovare alcuna posizione per te in questo momento.

entries.en: You need 4 players to fight with The Ravager.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di 4 giocatori per combattere con The Ravager.

entries.en: You need 5 players to fight with Death Priest Shargon.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di 5 giocatori per combattere con il Sacerdote della Morte Shargon.

entries.en: You need exactly 5 players to fight with Death Priest Shargon.
entries.translated: Hai bisogno esattamente di 5 giocatori per combattere con il Sacerdote della Morte Shargon.

entries.translated: Poiché questa è la tua prima volta come %s %s

entries.translated: Hai ricevuto le armi di un %s. %s
